description: This file defines a User class with methods for prompting user input, editing files, viewing pages, confirming actions, and opening URLs. It includes imports, logging setup, and class methods for user interaction and system operations.

classes.name: User
classes.description: A class providing user interaction utilities such as prompts, file editing, page viewing, confirmation, and URL opening.

methods.name: prompt
methods.description: Prompts the user with a message and returns the response.

methods.name: prompt_password
methods.description: Prompts the user for a password input.

methods.name: prompt_with_multiple_lists
methods.description: Displays multiple lists with subtitles and prompts the user to select items.

methods.name: _wait_on_list_response
methods.description: Handles user response for list selection, supporting multiple selections and ranges.

methods.name: prompt_with_list
methods.description: Displays a list and prompts the user to select an item.

methods.name: edit
methods.description: Opens specified files in the user's preferred editor.

methods.name: page
methods.description: Displays a message in a pager program.

methods.name: confirm
methods.description: Asks the user to confirm an action with a yes/no prompt.

methods.name: can_open_url
methods.description: Checks if the system can open URLs in a browser.

methods.name: open_url
methods.description: Opens a URL in the default web browser.
